The '''Alliance Diplomatic Corps''' was the branch of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] tasked with dealing with friendly states and potential allies. It was under the control of the [[Ministry of State (Alliance)|Ministry of State]].
